definitions.gloss: ready-made product; off-the-shelf item; mass-produced goods
definitions.explanation: products made in advance and sold in standard sizes or specifications, as opposed to custom-made or handmade items

examples.japanese: {既製品|きせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{既製品|きせいひん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There was no suitable size among the ready-made products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{既製品|きせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: Ready-made products are cheaper and faster than handmade ones.

notes:
FORMS:
{既製|きせい} (ready-made, pre-made) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item, goods)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧ (handmade) - opposite concept
- オーダー⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧ (custom-made) - opposite concept
- ⟦{注文品|ちゅうもんひん}→注文品：08964_chuumonhin⟧ (custom order item)

USAGE:
- {既製品|きせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (ready-to-wear clothing)
- ⟦{既製|きせい}{服|ふく}→既製服：19980_kiseifuku⟧ (ready-made clothes)
While {既製品|きせいひん} is neutral, it can sometimes imply less personalization compared to custom or handmade items.
